intent: Reject invalid closed public-operation inventory before traversing any operation effects through the existing semantic owner. This is an earliest-rejection slice, not complete lifecycle conformance.
requirements: Retain schema, source-language filtering and canonical unique population discovery.
Finish duplicate/stale/entrypoint/semantic-shape/function-inventory and missing-operation admission for the complete population before any validated_operation_effect_inventory call.
Preserve effect observation order, exact port counts, existing authority/read-only constraints and full traversal for admitted inputs.
Preserve Python/TypeScript and consumer-owned-schema compatibility, public imports and CLI grammar; no second graph, evaluator, registry or receipt.
expected_tests: Real existing operation inventories with missing, multiply classified, stale, wrong-entrypoint, contradictory semantic shape and absent function subjects must reject with original cause before any effect callback.
An admitted inventory executes existing effect query for every included operation in original order and retains exact observations.
Retain original semantic completeness negative-control search and execution; no weakening of runtime effect checks.
Affected semantic authority and TypeScript tests, architecture/lint/type/semantic/governance and applicable installed/private consumers before qualified completion.
forbidden: Maintained adopters and immutable predecessor bytes
Pinned lifecycle-consumer supervisor and other agents source trees
Hand-edited generated workflows or authority pins
Whole P32 closure, P33 activation or performance claims from this slice
evidence_rule: Contract commit then genuine ordering RED before production changes; preserve failures and exact subjects. Authored implementation status does not confer independent verified/closed truth.
